lines.japanese: 昼休みの学生食堂。
lines.english: The school cafeteria at lunchtime.

lines.japanese: 僕と渡来さんは、隅っこの席でもう二人の班員を待っていた。
lines.english: Watarai and I sat at a table in the corner, waiting for the other two members of our team.

lines.japanese: そういう約束をしたわけでもないけれど、最近はなんとなく、羽田班四人で食卓を囲む日が多かった。
lines.english: We had never made a particular arrangement, but lately the four members of the Haneda team somehow ended up eating together more often than not.

lines.japanese: 「山科遅いなー、何やってんだろ。針生先輩は──」
lines.english: “Yamashina's late. What's she doing? And Kuroudo—”

lines.japanese: 「──あれ？　あのひと、そもそも今日、学校来てたっけ？」
lines.english: “—wait. Did he even come to school today?”

lines.japanese: 「二時間目まではたしかにいたよ。気付いたら姿が消えてたけど、お昼だから戻ってくるんじゃ……」
lines.english: “He was definitely here through second period. He disappeared at some point, but he'll probably come back for lunch...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田、頼みがある」
lines.english: “Haneda. I have a favor to ask.”

lines.japanese: 噂をすれば影。針生蔵人そのひとがやってきた。
lines.english: Speak of the devil. Kuroudo Hariu himself appeared.

lines.japanese: 「浅はかな俺を嘲笑ってくれ」
lines.english: “Laugh at me for my shallowness.”

lines.japanese: 僕と渡来さんは揃って口を開ける。
lines.english: Watarai's mouth and mine fell open in unison.

lines.japanese: 「またこのおっさんは、いきなり現れてワケ分かんないことを……」
lines.english: “Here comes the old man again, appearing out of nowhere and talking complete nonsense...”

lines.japanese: 「らしくないですね、自虐的な針生さんなんて。いったいどうしたんですか」
lines.english: “Self-deprecation isn't like you, Kuroudo. What happened?”

lines.japanese: 「どうもこうもない。この宇宙に神だの創造主だのと呼ばれる意思が存在するとして、俺はいまその御心の一端を窺い知ってきたところだ」
lines.english: “Nothing ‘happened.’ If some will called God or the Creator exists in this universe, I've just returned from glimpsing a fragment of its design.”

lines.japanese: 「具体的には？」
lines.english: “In concrete terms?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきまで理事長室でギャルゲーやっててなァ」
lines.english: “I was playing a dating sim in the chairwoman's office until a minute ago.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、なんでおれも呼んでくれないんですか」
lines.english: “What? Why didn't you invite me?”

lines.japanese: 「授業中だからじゃない？」
lines.english: “Because class was in session?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、リッジーが『ラフブラス』買ったこと誰にも言うなって」
lines.english: “No. Lizzy told me not to tell anyone she'd bought *Rough Brass*.”

lines.japanese: 「友達かよ」
lines.english: “Since when are you buddies?”

lines.japanese: 「だけど、針生さんはもうギャルゲーを極めて卒業したんじゃ……？」
lines.english: “But I thought you had mastered dating sims and graduated from them...”

lines.japanese: 「ふン」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは失笑しながら、眼鏡のブリッジに指を添えた。いつもふらふらとさ迷っている視線が、僕をまっすぐに射ぬく。
lines.english: Kuroudo gave a scornful laugh and touched a finger to the bridge of his glasses. His gaze, usually drifting aimlessly, pierced straight into me.

lines.japanese: 「羽田。すまない、昨日までの俺は浅はかだった」
lines.english: “Haneda. Forgive me. Until yesterday, I was shallow.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、針生先輩がひとに頭下げたとこ初めて見た！」
lines.english: “Whoa. That's the first time I've ever seen Kuroudo bow his head to somebody!”

lines.japanese: 「言うなれば俺は、たかだか日本の山を制した程度で、世界の峻峰すべてを踏破した気になっていた」
lines.english: “I was like a man who had conquered a few little mountains in Japan and imagined he'd scaled every great summit on Earth.”

lines.japanese: 「しかしギャルゲーは、一朝一夕に極められるほどシンプルなカルチャーではなかった……まさか、まさか一個の自我を懐中に携帯するなど……それはすでに神の領域じゃないかッ！」
lines.english: “But dating sims were not a culture so simple that one could master them overnight... I never dreamed one could carry an entire consciousness in one's pocket... This has already entered the realm of God!”

lines.japanese: 「針生さん……」
lines.english: “Kuroudo...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君羽田君、同情する要素はどこにもないよ」
lines.english: “Haneda, Haneda. There is absolutely nothing here to sympathize with.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、僕には分かるんだ、針生さんの甘くせつない苦悩や葛藤が」
lines.english: “No. I understand the sweet, aching torment and conflict inside Kuroudo.”

lines.japanese: 「何故ってそれは、ラフブラスを始めた者なら誰もが越えねばならない、幸せへの通過儀礼だから」
lines.english: “Because everyone who begins *Rough Brass* must pass through this rite on the road to happiness.”

lines.japanese: 「こ、これに語りかけろと言うのか……この俺が、ヒトの造りし命の虚像に……」
lines.english: “Y-you expect me to speak to this... Me, address a false life fashioned by human hands...”

lines.japanese: 「だが、なんだ、この前頭葉を騒がせる未知の情感はなんだ……この悟りを開けば、俺は新たな階層へ上がれると言うのか……教えてくれ、羽田。俺を導いてくれ、羽田！」
lines.english: “But what is this unknown emotion stirring my frontal lobe? If I attain this enlightenment, will I rise to a new plane...? Teach me, Haneda. Guide me, Haneda!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、音声入力が恥ずかしいのは最初だけで、すぐに慣れちゃいますよ」
lines.english: “Oh, using voice input is only embarrassing at first. You get used to it very quickly.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君ごめん。私、先ごはん食べてるわ」
lines.english: “Sorry, Haneda. I'm going to start eating without you.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そうだね。今日はもう、山科さんも来ないみたいだし」
lines.english: “Oh, right. It doesn't look as if Yamashina is coming today.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、どうしたんだろ、急に緑化委員の仕事でも入ったのかな」
lines.english: “Yeah. What happened? Did she suddenly get some work for the campus gardening committee?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、あのボーダーガールだったら、いつもの無気力病でブッ倒れてたから保健室に放りこんどいた。そんなことよりラフブラスの話をしようぜ」
lines.english: “Oh, the Borderline Girl collapsed with her usual listlessness, so I tossed her into the nurse's office. More importantly, let's talk about *Rough Brass*.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ、駄目ですよ針生さん！　それ、呑気に雑談してる場合じゃないですよ！」
lines.english: “Wait, Kuroudo! We can't sit around chatting! This isn't the time!”

lines.japanese: 携帯ゲームを始めてしまった針生さんを学食に残し、僕と渡来さんは保健室へ向かった。
lines.english: Leaving Kuroudo in the cafeteria as he started up his handheld game, Watarai and I headed for the nurse's office.

lines.japanese: お見舞い、と言ったら大袈裟になってしまうけれど、友人として彼女の具合が心配でならなかった。
lines.english: Calling it a visit might have sounded too dramatic, but as her friends, we couldn't help worrying about her condition.

lines.japanese: 「失礼します」
lines.english: “Excuse us.”

lines.japanese: 「山科いるー？」
lines.english: “Yamashina, you in here?”

lines.japanese: ベッドに横たわっていた山科さんは、くすんだ瞳に僕たちの姿を捕えると、ひどく重たげにのっそり半身を起こした。
lines.english: Yamashina lay on a bed. When her dull eyes found us, she sluggishly raised her upper body as though it weighed a tremendous amount.

lines.japanese: 「んん……どうしたの、ふたり揃って……」
lines.english: “Mmm... What are both of you doing here...?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、いいのに寝たままで」
lines.english: “Oh, you don't have to get up.”

lines.japanese: 「はっ……やだ、私いま、ひょっとしてお見舞いに来てくれたんじゃないかなんて、心底あつかましい考えに至っちゃった」
lines.english: “Ah... How awful. For one moment I arrived at the shameless conclusion that perhaps you had come to visit me.”

lines.japanese: 「ふふ……こんな愚図を気にかけるひとなんて、いやしないのにね。思い上がりも大概にするべきだよ」
lines.english: “Hehe... No one would ever concern themselves with a dullard like me. There should be limits to one's conceit.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんはあらぬ方を見詰めながら、聞きとりにくい声でぶつぶつ呟いていた。
lines.english: Yamashina stared off in the wrong direction, muttering too softly for us to make out clearly.

lines.japanese: 「山科さん、見るからに辛そうだよ。まだ起きない方がいいって」
lines.english: “You look miserable, Yamashina. You really shouldn't get up yet.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……そうだよね。私みたいな愚図は永劫ベッドに伏して、ひとり寂しく朽ちてゆくべきだよね」
lines.english: “Yes... You're right. A dullard like me should lie in bed forever and rot away alone.”

lines.japanese: 「世界には砂の上でしか眠れない子供もいるって言うのに、ただこの国に生みおとされただけの理由で安らかなシーツに横たわれる私は、本当に両親ひいては山科家代々の系譜に感謝してもしきれないよ」
lines.english: “There are children in the world with nowhere to sleep but the sand, yet merely by being born in this country, I may lie upon peaceful sheets. I could never adequately thank my parents, nor the whole ancestral line of the Yamashina family.”

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫かな……」
lines.english: “Do you think she's all right...?”

lines.japanese: 僕は渡来さんに小声で相談した。
lines.english: I whispered the question to Watarai.

lines.japanese: 「いや、だめでしょ。家のひとに知らせて、帰らせた方がいいと思う」
lines.english: “No, obviously not. We should call her family and send her home.”

lines.japanese: 「山科ん家、共働きだけど、たしかおばあちゃんがいるって言ってたから──」
lines.english: “Yamashina's parents both work, but I think she said her grandmother lives with them—”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、おばあちゃん。ごめんなさい、おばあちゃん。こんな孫を学校まで迎えに来させてごめんなさい」
lines.english: “Oh, Grandmother. I'm sorry, Grandmother. Forgive this wretched grandchild for making you come all the way to school.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、もう来てくれることになってるんだ。よかった」
lines.english: “Oh, so she's already coming. That's good.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、本当に。こういうとき、家族ほど頼りになるものはないよね。なのに私は何もできない役立たずでごめんなさい」
lines.english: “Yes, truly. At times like these, nothing is more dependable than family. Yet I'm sorry that I'm a useless creature who can do nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君も家族は大切にした方がいいよ。家族は最後の砦だからね。ああでも私ったら、羽田君にこんな偉そうなことを言って何様のつもりだろう」
lines.english: “You should treasure your family too, Haneda. Family is the final bastion. Ah, but what right have I to speak so loftily to you?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことないよ、おれも家族はすごく大切に思ってるんだ。山科さんの言うとおりだよ」
lines.english: “That's not true. My family matters enormously to me too. You're absolutely right, Yamashina.”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう。だけどそれは私が言うまでもなく、羽田君のように聡明なひとなら当然知っていることだったよね。それをしたり顔で語ってしまった自分を、いますぐ馬鹿だと罵りたいよ」
lines.english: “Thank you. But someone as wise as you naturally knew that without being told. I want to call myself an idiot this instant for lecturing you with such a knowing look.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、フォローすればするほどドツボにハマってくなー」
lines.english: “Hmm. The more we reassure her, the deeper she sinks.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんなさい……この屑を濾過した残渣のような私が、人並みにものを語ってごめんなさい……」
lines.english: “I'm sorry... Forgive me for presuming to speak like a human being when I'm no more than the residue left after the dregs have been strained away...”

lines.japanese: 「おれだってそんな大した人間じゃないよ。家族の大切さにしても、本当の意味で実感できたのは、最近になってのことなんだ」
lines.english: “I'm not such an impressive person either. Even when it comes to how precious family is, I only began to understand it in the truest sense recently.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのー、羽田君？　いまの山科に真っ向から応えてあげるのは、かえって酷だと思うけど……」
lines.english: “Um, Haneda? I think answering Yamashina head-on right now might actually be crueler...”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ。渡来さんにもそのうち会ってもらいたいな、僕の家族に」
lines.english: “That's right. Watarai, I'd like you to meet my family soon too.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「どういうこと？　羽田君はまだ恋人に家族を紹介してなかったの？」
lines.english: “What do you mean? You still haven't introduced your girlfriend to your family?”

lines.japanese: 「はっ……ごめんなさい、私は絞り滓のくせに、いま分も弁えずひとりの全き人間を咎めようとしました。ああ、嫌になる。まったく何なんだろう、この滓は。沈めよ」
lines.english: “Ah... Forgive me. Though I am mere pressed dregs, I just tried to rebuke a whole and complete human being without knowing my place. Oh, how loathsome. What is this filth? Sink to the bottom.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、分かるよ。山科さんは間違ってない」
lines.english: “No, I understand. Yamashina isn't wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよね、渡来さん。僕ら、お互いの家族に会っておくべきじゃないかな」
lines.english: “You're right, Watarai. Shouldn't we meet each other's families?”

lines.japanese: 「え……あの、なに走りだしてんの、君の思考」
lines.english: “What... Why did your train of thought suddenly start sprinting?”

lines.japanese: 「だって挨拶しておいた方がいいでしょ、いずれ家族になるひとなんだから」
lines.english: “Because it would be better to introduce ourselves. We're going to be family someday.”
“Wh—”

lines.japanese: 「──なに言ってんの！？」
lines.english: “—what are you talking about?!”

lines.japanese: 「ああごめんなさい、私のせいで、渡来さんにほのかな含羞を覚えさせてしまってごめんなさい。この滓が引いた引き金によって、渡来さんに予期せぬ恥辱を与えてしまってごめんなさい」
lines.english: “Oh, forgive me. Because of me, Watarai has experienced the faint blush of maidenly shame. Forgive these dregs for pulling the trigger that inflicted an unexpected humiliation upon her.”

lines.japanese: 「やっ、ちょ、恥ず……かしくはないけどさあっ」
lines.english: “H-hey, I'm not... embarrassed or anything!”

lines.japanese: 「本当……？　じゃあ渡来さんは家のひとに羽田君を紹介するんだね。さもなくば私は大きな過ちを犯したことになる……死をもって罪を償い、たちどころに塵と消えるべきだよね」
lines.english: “Truly...? Then you will introduce Haneda to your family, won't you? Otherwise, I will have committed a grave mistake... I should atone with my life and instantly crumble into dust.”

lines.japanese: 「落ちついて、大丈夫だよ山科さん。おれ、明日にでも渡来さんの実家に行ってくるから」
lines.english: “Calm down, Yamashina. Everything's fine. I'll visit Watarai's family home tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！？」
lines.english: “Whaaaat?!”

lines.japanese: その後、山科さんはお祖母さんに連れられて帰っていった。
lines.english: After that, Yamashina's grandmother came and took her home.

lines.japanese: 「そういうわけなんだけど、渡来さんのお母さんのご都合はどうかな」
lines.english: “So that's what happened. Do you think tomorrow works for your mother?”

lines.japanese: 「え、さっきのアレ本気なの……」
lines.english: “Wait, you were serious about that...?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはあまり乗り気じゃなさそうだったけど、ものすごく嫌がってるというわけでもなさそうだったので、僕はメールを送ってもらうことにした。
lines.english: Watarai didn't seem particularly enthusiastic, but she didn't seem fiercely opposed either, so I had her send an email.

lines.japanese: 「どうしよう、緊張するなあ」
lines.english: “What am I going to do? I'm nervous.”

lines.japanese: 「自分から言いだしといて……じゃ、やめる？」
lines.english: “You were the one who suggested it... Want to call it off?”

lines.japanese: 「まさか。ちょっと逃げだしたくなってきたけど、今更そんな失礼なことできないよ」
lines.english: “Of course not. I'm starting to want to run away, but backing out now would be terribly rude.”

lines.japanese: そして二時間後ぐらいに、いつでも連れてこいとの返信があったらしい。
lines.english: About two hours later, she apparently received a reply telling her to bring me anytime.

lines.japanese: その旨を報告する渡来さんは実にあっさりしていて、逆に僕の方がそわそわと落ち着きを失っていた。
lines.english: Watarai reported the news with perfect calm. I, on the other hand, grew restless and unable to settle down.

lines.japanese: さっきまでとまるで逆だ。
lines.english: The complete reverse of how we had been a moment earlier.
